note: Every platform service uses the My Space atom. Series: AI = rose (Mind + Flow), Web = green (Browser + Connect), Shell = cyan (Shell atlas + Scripts runtime for My Space Language), Link = violet (MSL + Pulse + Parts + Resolve). Platform = white atom majors without a color series (Files, Jobs, Scheduler, Permissions, Themes, …). My Space Language orchestrates the OS and, with host languages (Python, Node, …), lets users build My Space apps and artifacts — Shell maps it, Scripts runs programs, host(…) runs app logic when wired. Not MSL (My Space Link).

services.name: My Space OS
services.tagline: Personal desktop layer on your OS
services.summary: Desktop, windows/tabs, pins, focus, wallpaper, and launching internal or external programs inside one shell.

services.name: Browser
services.summary: Workspace web tabs, address bar, and My Space Browser: browse without leaving the shell.

services.name: Connect
services.tagline: Find and open web services inside My Space
services.summary: Service catalog (not a desktop app): mail, messaging, social, browsers, and more. Open from the search icon on the taskbar or tab bar. Looks the same as before.

services.name: Shell
services.summary: Entry map for My Space Language: orchestration grammar, live operations, and the build roadmap (host interop with Python/Node, app scaffold, pack). Type on the desktop line; author programs in Scripts; use host languages for app-internal logic. Shell is not the language and not the runtime.

services.name: Scripts
services.tagline: Runtime for My Space Language programs
services.summary: Save and run multi-line programs written in My Space Language (not a separate language). Scripts is the runtime/library; Shell is the atlas; platform services are what many operations call. Open from Platform → Scripts. Language: scripts(…).

services.name: MSL
services.summary: Full app for the capability bus: browse providers, mint msl:v1 keys, manage the library, and inject into AI apps. Open from Platform → MSL. Shell: msl(open) · msl(list) · msl(invoke …).

services.name: Parts
services.summary: Full app catalog of clean, reusable code parts (search helpers, UI fragments, data utilities). Browse like a forge, open a part like a repo, adopt by copying files — written without host-app coupling. Complements MSL (live calls) and Pulse (messages). Shell: parts(…).

services.name: Pulse
services.tagline: Link Bus: internal apps & Composio external tools
services.summary: Cross-app messaging bus for internal apps and Composio external tools. Per-app command profiles (pulse.json), send/subscribe, plus External tab for API key, Connect Links, and toolkit sync. Complements MSL. Shell: pulse(…) · pulse(external).

services.name: Resolve
services.summary: Platform service for app incidents: apps report via Pulse in real time, Resolve matches playbooks, and you apply fixes from the inbox. Shell: resolve(…) · pulse(send resolve report …).

services.name: Jobs
services.summary: Full compute runtime app (not a desktop tile): queue, active, done, enqueue, and capacity pools: Interactive, Connect, Shell, Background. Connect opens are prioritized. Uses the default My Space atom — not a branded logo series. Shell: jobs(open) · jobs(list) · jobs(capacity).

services.name: Scheduler
services.tagline: OS time runtime: when work fires
services.summary: Platform time contracts (not a desktop tile): active schedules, history, and create. Triggers: every / daily / in / at. Actions enqueue to Jobs by default (or run shell direct). Same store as schedule(…) in Shell and Scripts. Complements Jobs (compute) and Shell when (events). Shell: schedule(open) · schedule(list) · schedule(add every 1h …).

services.name: Updates
services.summary: Platform release service (not a desktop tile): your installed version, new major updates on this page (not the bell), Restart & Update, skip, and full changelog from config/updates.json. Open from Platform → Updates. Shell: updates(open).

services.name: Network
services.summary: Platform network service (not a desktop tile): online status, primary IP, reachability probes (DNS / internet / Gemini / GitHub), adapters, and listening ports. Opens Windows Network settings when needed. Shell: network(open) · network(status) · network(check).

services.name: Info
services.summary: Platform catalog (not a desktop tile): every app and every Platform service with about text, surfaces, live digests, and storage. Filter All · Services · Apps · External. Shell: info(open) · info(services).

services.name: Backup
services.summary: Platform backup service (not a desktop tile): export userData to a zip, restore from zip (restarts), history of exports/restores, and open the data folder. Shell: backup(open) · backup(export) · backup(status).

services.name: Storage
services.summary: Platform storage service (not a desktop tile): host drive usage, per-app userData breakdown, large-file scan, and safe cleanup inside userData. Shell: storage(open) · storage(status) · storage(apps) · storage(cleanup).

services.name: Themes
services.summary: Platform appearance: light/dark + button styles for desktop apps and platform services. Live apply. Shell: themes(open) · themes(files dark) · themes(today light) · themes(list).

services.name: Mind
services.tagline: OS AI runtime — conversations, tasks, models
services.summary: Platform AI control plane (not a desktop app). Everyday · Quick · Deep. Long-term Memory for facts and preferences. Gemini key and optional Ollama in Setup.

services.name: Model Flow
services.tagline: AI plans tool flows: you approve before they run
services.summary: Personal automation studio (not a desktop app): plan → edit → approve → run. Shell: flow(…). Connects to Model Lab as an external provider — Lab is not a My Space service.

services.name: Search
services.summary: Command palette and desktop search across apps, content, Connect services, and web suggestions.

services.name: Notifications
services.summary: Update banners, mail alerts, sender blocklist, and quiet control from the taskbar bell.

services.name: System Info
services.summary: Live view of this PC inside My Space (not a desktop app). Open from Platform → System Info. Shell: sysinfo(…) / sys(…). Looks the same as before.

services.name: OS Bridge
services.summary: Connect this PC to your phone from Platform (not a desktop tile). Pairing panel, send files, clipboard+, device management, inbox uploads, host places & Windows settings. Shell: bridge(panel) · bridge(full). Remote Hub stays separate.

services.name: Files
services.tagline: Browse this PC inside My Space
services.summary: OS file browser (not a desktop tile): places, drives, favorites, recent, preview, and file actions. Open from Platform → Files. Shell: files(…) · files(panel) · files(full). MSL: files.dir.list / files.path.open.

services.name: Permissions
services.tagline: What Mind, Jobs, Bridge & alerts may do
services.summary: Full access-control app (not a desktop tile): AI tools, mutating-action confirmations, mail blocklist, Jobs capacity gates, Bridge trusted devices, and Composio allowlist. Open from Platform → Permissions. Shell: permissions(…) · perms(…).
